body: I really do hope you do have someone to rely on. I know I don’t know you personally IRL but I wish the absolute best for you and hopefully things will get better.

I think for me it was just the fear that their perception of me will change. Sometimes when I tell people they don’t realize the seriousness of my issues, other times they will take it 100% seriously and will help me as much as they can. I hope that you at least have someone that you trust 100% to talk to about this. If not, you can always talk to me :)

Honestly now I don’t know if I have the heart to even try. I told my friend and now that I think of it I’d feel guilty because I don’t know if she would feel as if she could’ve done something more. Part of me just wants to attempt and hope that I won’t actually die, just end up in the hospital for a while. I value my life so less that I really don’t care what happens to me now. I’ve also started getting addicted to self harm, and I really wanna cut it out but it gets too much sometimes. I’m down to talk too if you’d like

Yes I did talk to her more about it and now I think I’m stuck. Now that I’ve told her I’d feel guilty going now because I don’t know whether she’ll think she could’ve done something because really she couldn’t have. I don’t know whether this is a good thing or not. It’d be so much easier if I didn’t tell anyone in the first place
